rationale: The bid-ask spread of 139 bps is extremely wide relative to the ATR of $0.18 (roughly 50 bps per side), meaning the spread alone consumes most of a typical intraday move and creates an immediate structural disadvantage for any entry. Price is pinned at the session high with minimal range development (only $0.21 range so far), offering no clear directional setup or pullback entry. With no news catalyst and the position already at 100% of today's range, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable given transaction costs.
